purpose: Obtain independent leakage-resistant structural gold for the six source-custody-qualified public-domain heldout cases without exposing gold to Candidate-002 and without creating manuscript, canon or promotion authority.
required_human_event: Independent adjudicators complete the gold-empty task packets under HUMAN-ADJUDICATION-PACKET-CONTRACT-v1.json. For high-risk tasks, two independent reviews are required. Any disagreement not resolvable from source evidence remains explicit disagreement/UNRESOLVED rather than fabricated consensus.
machine_actions_forbidden_until_human_ev: Do not claim heldout model accuracy or calibration.
Do not score against fabricated, inferred or assistant-authored gold.
Do not expose adjudication labels, forbidden labels or adjudication notes to the model backend.
Do not mutate canonical narrative state, manuscript content, publication state or canon.
Do not treat hosted source-custody PASS as A-01 or promotion authority.

resume_after_human_event.first_machine_action: Validate every completed adjudication packet against HUMAN-ADJUDICATION-PACKET-CONTRACT-v1.json and the exact passage digests in SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A-HOSTED-QUALIFICATION-RECEIPT-v1.json.
resume_after_human_event.next_gate: Freeze one real learned/model backend prediction set with model gold visibility false, then expose gold to the scorer only after prediction freeze and compute per-task precision/recall/F1, false-certainty, ambiguity preservation, calibration and anchor-quality evidence.
resume_after_human_event.pass_proves: Candidate-002 has real human-adjudicated source-heldout model evidence under leakage-resistant source, provider and scorer boundaries.
resume_after_human_event.pass_does_not_prove: Universal literary understanding, author intent, manuscript mutation authority, A-01 authority or production/promotion authority.
resume_after_human_event.on_failure: Repair only the failing adjudication-contract, gold-isolation, provider, prediction-freeze, task-family, false-certainty, ambiguity, calibration or scoring boundary; do not replace frozen passages because of model underperformance.

a01_reason: The unresolved completion delta is independent human adjudication. A-01 cannot create or substitute that evidence. Reevaluate only after human adjudication and hosted real-model scoring produce a new exact-SHA runner-specific qualification delta.
